executedSuites.scope: Delivered catalogue HTML, controllers, combat engine, automatic RAF loop and replay validation. Trusted Chromium keyboard at desktop and narrow viewports. Raster artwork uses a one-pixel fixture; this is not visual-fidelity, physical-device or touch certification. Unit cases separately cover both facings and mixed input devices.

Delivered catalogue HTML, controller, automatic RAF loop, real combat and deterministic replay validation. Trusted Chromium keyboard and mouse at 1280/390 px; pause/reset isolation cases explicitly use DOM/API activation. Raster artwork uses a one-pixel fixture. No physical-device, real assistive-technology or artistic-fidelity certification.

Delivered catalogue HTML, controllers, combat engine, replay validation and automatic RAF loop. Browser-generated visible blur/focus with focus emulation explicitly disabled, trusted keyboard/pointer events, actual BFCache restoration, and separately labelled synthetic visibility boundaries. Standard gamepad and raster images are explicit fixtures; no physical controller, touch-device, or visual-fidelity certification.

Delivered menu HTML, CSS and controllers with trusted Chromium keyboard events. Image requests use a one-pixel fixture; no visual-art fidelity, full combat, hardware keyboard, physical gamepad or complete remapping certification.

Delivered performance page and monitor in Chromium, with explicit same-origin iframe fixtures in place of game modes. Includes trusted BFCache restoration and separate synthetic lifecycle coverage. No full-game, physical-FPS, GPU-memory or real-device certification.

Delivered audio/sprites HTML and CSS, unchanged native fonts, actual 100%/200% root text at 320px and ordinary 1280px viewport. External scripts are explicit inert fixtures; static headings only. Original R31 browser suites separately verify populated pages, media and interactions. No artwork fidelity or physical-device certification.

Actual motion page, original reader, native manifests and SHA-verified decoded atlases. Trusted Chromium keyboard, native button click synthesis and native select/slider behavior at1280/390px. Only the page-controller source is substituted for the exact baseline phase. Baseline failures are required for the three known defects; all baseline controls and all current cases must pass. No physical-device or assistive-technology certification.

Delivered evolution HTML, controller, engine and deterministic replay; exact prior controller is the only baseline substitution. Eight groups per phase use the production automatic RAF loop. Two eligibility groups explicitly simulate RAF and reach eligibility through real engine ticks without health/resource overrides. Keyboard, pointer, visible blur/focus and BFCache events are generated by Chromium. Standard gamepad and raster artwork are explicit fixtures for this focused suite. The unchanged existing R28 recipe runs separately on current source and real assets. No physical-device or artistic-fidelity certification.

Actual gallery HTML, CSS and page controller; metadata comes from the unchanged R31 manifest. The registry API, asynchronous outcomes and decoded one-pixel images are explicit fixtures. Trusted Chromium mouse and native keyboard activation at1280/390px. Synthetic pagehide/pageshow test controller boundaries, not actual BFCache eligibility. Before and after differ only in the page-controller response. No original image provenance, visual fidelity, physical device, real registry budget, combat or replay certification. The unchanged R31 browser recipe separately covers actual media in CI.
